scope: Exercise the MLEADER block-content branch through strict dx_iface output, including its typed BLOCK_RECORD dependency and block body

authority.title: Autodesk MLeader Context Data Group Codes (DXF)
rules: The context schema distinguishes MTEXT presence (group 290) from block-content presence (group 296).
Block content carries normal, position, scale, rotation, color, referenced BLOCK_RECORD, and transformation fields.

authority.title: Autodesk MLeader Leader Line Group Codes (DXF)
authority.rule: The content branch is nested alongside the independent leader-root and leader-line geometry.

behavior: The runtime-generated AC1027 ASCII and Binary input has hasTextContents=false, hasContentsBlock=true, one leader root and one leader line.
Its block context references an alternate BLOCK_RECORD with a generated BLOCK body containing one LINE; no fixture is committed.
Strict adapter output and fresh readback preserve the block normal, position, scale, rotation, all 16 transform values, and the remapped content BLOCK_RECORD reference.
Readback confirms the referenced content BLOCK_RECORD body still contains its LINE, and output does not mutate the caller's source handle, owner, style handle, or block transform model.
The text-content profile's independent unsupported-CMC atomic refusal and corrected same-adapter retry remain covered by the same focused selector.

control.generator: Extended generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp; ASCII/Binary inputs and outputs are generated in a temporary directory and deleted.
control.fixtureDisposition: No drawing fixture was added or committed.
control.profileLimit: Generated AC1027 block-content transport only; no producer-authored legality is inferred for other content-flag/type combinations.

limitations: Generated source and typed readback verify transport, not producer tuple legality, independent semantic interpretation, or native annotation rendering/evaluation.
No physical DWG producer, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, or native CAD consumer was exercised.
Other MLEADER content and version profiles remain open or refused; no format-support claim is promoted.
